name: aortoiliac_svmp_iliac
description: Aorto-iliac segment (distal abdominal aorta continuing into the left common iliac, with the right common iliac branching off), rigid-wall CFD, pulsatile inflow, RCR outlets. The geometry Stanford already uses as its 'iliac' performance case, offered here at benchmark resolutions.

source.repository: SimVascular/svMultiPhysics tests (tests/cases/fluid/iliac_artery/mesh), exterior surface of the test mesh
source.note: SimVascular example geometry (aortofemoral demo family); face names taken from the test case's mesh-surfaces file names

license: svMultiPhysics repository license (BSD-style, see LICENSE.txt in SimVascular/svMultiPhysics); test data distributed with the repository
face_name_note: Names follow the svMultiPhysics test case: cap_aorta is the proximal (inlet) cap (d 2.4 cm), cap_aorta_2 the distal aortic/left iliac outlet (d 1.0), cap_right_iliac the right iliac outlet (d 1.1).
